metadata.description: Reusable Claude Code skills with built-in evaluation framework

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Development workflow guidance: planning, TDD with Gherkin, code quality, git discipline

plugins.name: python-style
plugins.description: Python style conventions: type annotations, docstrings, PEP 8, streaming patterns

plugins.name: skill-orchestration
plugins.description: Meta-skill that instructs the agent to invoke all relevant skills, not just the first match

plugins.name: secure-coding
plugins.description: Secure coding rules from OWASP Top 10:2025, ASVS 5.0, Proactive Controls 2024, NIST SSDF (SP 800-218 / 800-218A), and CSF 2.0

plugins.name: api-design
plugins.description: REST API contract design rules from Google AIP, Microsoft Azure REST Guidelines, OpenAPI 3.1, and RFC 9457

plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: OpenTelemetry instrumentation, structured logging, and SLI/SLO practices from OTel semantic conventions, Google SRE workbook, and 12-Factor App

plugins.name: acceptance-criteria
plugins.description: Requirements specification and acceptance criteria practices from ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148, BDD, and ISO 25010

plugins.name: efficient-code
plugins.description: Language-neutral algorithmic efficiency: data structure selection, Big-O awareness, space complexity, and profile-before-optimize discipline

plugins.name: efficient-code-python
plugins.description: Python-specific efficiency: stdlib helpers (set, dict, collections, heapq, bisect, functools.cache) and idioms that apply the efficient-code principles

plugins.name: efficient-code-c
plugins.description: C efficiency: stdlib (memcpy/memmove/qsort/bsearch), pass-by-value copies, strict aliasing, VLAs, restrict, signed overflow UB, and LTO/perf flags

plugins.name: efficient-code-cpp
plugins.description: C++ efficiency: STL containers (vector/unordered_map/span), copy/move semantics, reserve, virtual dispatch, string_view, RVO, and compiler optimizations

plugins.name: efficient-code-csharp
plugins.description: C# efficiency: Span/Memory/ArrayPool, StringBuilder, struct vs class, boxing, LINQ allocation, ValueTask, ref structs, and BenchmarkDotNet discipline

plugins.name: efficient-code-javascript
plugins.description: JavaScript efficiency: Map/Set over arrays, TypedArrays, V8 hidden classes, monomorphic call sites, holey arrays, and for-loop vs forEach gotchas

plugins.name: efficient-code-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript efficiency: type erasure, const enum vs enum, decorator cost, tsc target impact, and JS runtime gotchas that all TS code inherits

plugins.name: efficient-code-rust
plugins.description: Rust efficiency: Vec::with_capacity, String vs &str, iterator chains as zero-cost, Box/Rc/Arc tradeoffs, bounds check elision, and release-build discipline

plugins.name: efficient-code-php
plugins.description: PHP efficiency: array copy-on-write, foreach by-ref pitfalls, OPCache and preloading, interned strings, typed properties, and JIT scope

plugins.name: efficient-code-go
plugins.description: Go efficiency: slice growth and leaks, strings.Builder, interface boxing, escape analysis, defer cost, and sync.Pool for transient allocations
